reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Kansas
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate landlords with minimal rental properties?
    (e.g., <=5 single family homes; <=3 homes/rental properties; <=3 condo/co-op units)
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (question facts)
   ========================= */

state(kansas).
focus_year(2021).

/* Minimal-landlord categories referenced by the question (not Kansas-specific; these are the query targets). */
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(five_or_fewer_single_family_homes, max(5)).
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_fewer_homes_or_rental_properties, max(3)).
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_fewer_condo_or_coop_units, max(3)).

/* Helper that succeeds when the factual statement (the scenario) is fully encoded. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(five_or_fewer_single_family_homes, max(5)),
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_fewer_homes_or_rental_properties, max(3)),
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_fewer_condo_or_coop_units, max(3)).

/* ==========================================
   Statutes encoded as structured "features"
   ========================================== */

/* KS Stat  58-25,103 (2021) - Mobile home parks residential landlord-tenant act definitions.
   We encode key definitions as statute_feature/3 terms.

   Note: This section provides definitions (e.g., "landlord") and does not state any
   numeric landlord-portfolio thresholds (like <=5 homes, <=3 units, etc.).
*/
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_103, landlord, mobile_home_park_owner_lessor_sublessor_or_manager_who_fails_to_disclose)).
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_103, mobile_home_park, site_with_two_or_more_occupied_mobile_homes)).
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_103, tenant, person_entitled_under_rental_agreement_to_occupy_mobile_home_space)).

/* KS Stat  58-2543 (2021) - Kansas Residential Landlord and Tenant Act definitions.
   Encodes key definitions.

   Note: This section provides definitions and does not state any numeric landlord-portfolio thresholds.
*/
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_43, landlord, dwelling_unit_owner_lessor_sublessor_or_manager_who_fails_to_disclose)).
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_43, action, includes_action_for_possession)).
statute_feature(kansas, 2021, definition(ks_58_25_43, single_family_residence, structure_maintained_and_used_as_single_dwelling_unit_with_direct_access_and_no_shared_essential_services)).

/* ============================================================
   Legal translation helpers: detect "explicit minimal-landlord
   (small landlord) regulation" by numeric portfolio thresholds
   ============================================================ */

/* We treat "explicitly regulates minimal-property landlords" as:
   the statute text (as encoded) contains an explicit numeric threshold that targets
   landlord portfolio size (e.g., <=5 single family homes, <=3 properties, <=3 condo/co-op units).

   In this program, such targeting would be represented by a feature of the form:
     statute_feature(State, Year, minimal_landlord_threshold(Category, max(N))).

   Because the provided Kansas statutes are definitions-only and include no such thresholds,
   no statute_feature/3 clause of that form exists.
*/

statute_has_minimal_landlord_threshold(State, Year, Category, max(N)) :-
    statute_feature(State, Year, minimal_landlord_threshold(Category, max(N))).

/* Does any Kansas (State/Year) eviction-related statute (as provided/encoded) explicitly regulate
   landlords based on minimal portfolio size, matching any category in the scenario? */
explicit_minimal_landlord_regulation_applies_to_scenario(State, Year) :-
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(Category, max(N)),
    statute_has_minimal_landlord_threshold(State, Year, Category, max(N)).

/* =========================
   Answer computation
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    scenario_statement,
    explicit_minimal_landlord_regulation_applies_to_scenario(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate landlords with minimal rental properties? This includes includes: landlords who own five or fewer single family homes; landlords who own three or less homes or rental properties; and owners of three or less condominium or cooperative units.
